arguments.text: 10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m out-and-back. Goal fastest finish. 1) Let the start settle; pod power should come to about CP (pod 195 W, boat 122 W) by min 3; ease if still well above CP at min 3. 2) Hold just at/under CP mid-race, watch reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) and HR trend; consider one short test piece to check CP if HR/reserve disagree. 3) Watch for incidents: speed dips at steady pod power (weed on rudder -> clear_rudder), pod vs GPS disagreement (pod drift), radio course change (set_race_distance + tell), wind shifts. 4) Spend reserve over last ~1.5-2 km; finish cue around 600-800 m to go.

10 km, 8 legs of 1250 m; odd legs (out, north) have current/wind helping ~+0.27 m/s, even legs (back) against. CP pod measured in-race ~212 W (HR flat at 208, climbing 1.3 bpm/min at 222); boat CP ~133. Pacing: about 207-210 W pod on helping legs, ~218-220 W on legs against the current (time there is longer, so watts there buy more), ease/push cue at each turn if needed. Keep pod reserve (w_bal_pod_frac) above ~25 pct until 2 km to go, then spend it: push at ~2000 m to go, finish cue ~600 m. Paddler overconfident (says great, wants to surge): restrain early surges. Watch for incidents: speed dip at steady pod power (weed -> clear_rudder), pod vs GPS/HR disagreement (pod drift), radio course change (set_race_distance + tell), wind shift (push changes).

arguments.evidence: Pod reading slid 218->172 W over 830-945 s while boat-model power held and HR rose. At fixed share 0.616, GPS minus still-water speed shifted +0.13 m/s out (0.273->0.406) AND +0.12 back (-0.274->-0.155): same sign both ways = pod reading low, not current (fitted push unchanged 0.277). Speed implies true effort ~190-199 W vs pod 167-173 -> gain ~0.87.
